question: For CZK-paying customers in 2012 and 2013, compute the percentage change in total consumption between the two years for each of the segments SME, LAM, and KAM. Then, identify which segment had the largest absolute percentage change.

prediction.sql:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."XCL_002" AS segment,
        CASE 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
        END AS year,
        SUM(y."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c."XCL_001" = y."XCL_019"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND (y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' OR y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%')
      AND c."XCL_002" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."XCL_002", 
             CASE 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
             END
),
segment_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        s2012.segment,
        s2012.total_consumption AS total_2012,
        s2013.total_consumption AS total_2013,
        ((s2013.total_consumption - s2012.total_consumption) * 100.0 / s2012.total_consumption) AS pct_change
    FROM yearly_consumption s2012
    INNER JOIN yearly_consumption s2013 ON s2012.segment = s2013.segment
    WHERE s2012.year = 2012
      AND s2013.year = 2013
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    pct_change,
    ABS(pct_change) AS abs_pct_change
FROM segment_changes
ORDER BY abs_pct_change DESC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."XCL_002" AS segment,
        CASE 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
        END AS year,
        SUM(y."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c."XCL_001" = y."XCL_019"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND (y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' OR y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%')
      AND c."XCL_002" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."XCL_002", 
             CASE 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
             END
),
segment_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        s2012.segment,
        s2012.total_consumption AS total_2012,
        s2013.total_consumption AS total_2013,
        ((s2013.total_consumption - s2012.total_consumption) * 100.0 / s2012.total_consumption) AS pct_change
    FROM yearly_consumption s2012
    INNER JOIN yearly_consumption s2013 ON s2012.segment = s2013.segment
    WHERE s2012.year = 2012
      AND s2013.year = 2013
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    pct_change,
    ABS(pct_change) AS abs_pct_change
FROM segment_changes
ORDER BY abs_pct_change DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."XCL_002" AS segment,
        CASE 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
            WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
        END AS year,
        SUM(y."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c."XCL_001" = y."XCL_019"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND (y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' OR y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%')
      AND c."XCL_002" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."XCL_002", 
             CASE 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN 2012 
                 WHEN y."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN 2013 
             END
),
segment_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        s2012.segment,
        s2012.total_consumption AS total_2012,
        s2013.total_consumption AS total_2013,
        ((s2013.total_consumption - s2012.total_consumption) * 100.0 / s2012.total_consumption) AS pct_change
    FROM yearly_consumption s2012
    INNER JOIN yearly_consumption s2013 ON s2012.segment = s2013.segment
    WHERE s2012.year = 2012
      AND s2013.year = 2013
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    pct_change,
    ABS(pct_change) AS abs_pct_change
FROM segment_changes
ORDER BY abs_pct_change DESC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_003 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2013-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'CZK'
      AND c.XCL_003 IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
),
pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        total_2012,
        total_2013,
        (total_2013 - total_2012) * 100.0 / total_2012 AS pct_change
    FROM consumption
    WHERE total_2012 > 0
)
SELECT
    segment,
    pct_change
FROM pct_change
ORDER BY ABS(pct_change) DESC
LIMIT 1
